rows.label: SONNET

rows.label: SESSION

rows.label: LATEST

rows.label: ADVANCEMENT

rows.label: DIRECTORY

rows.label: LOVE LYRIC

rows.label: IMPROMPTU

rows.label: CODE FLAG

rows.label: ETYMOLOGY

rows.label: DETERMINER

rows.label: DRIVEL

rows.label: LEER

rows.label: BLUE NOTE

rows.label: COMMAND LINE

rows.label: ORATORY

rows.label: DERIVING

rows.label: BRANDISH

rows.label: PARLEY

rows.label: EMPTY WORDS

rows.label: DIGRAPH

rows.label: TITLE

rows.label: BOILERPLATE

rows.label: ADDUCING

rows.label: SPORTSCAST

rows.label: SOURCE CODE

rows.label: APOLOGY

rows.label: DETAIL FILE

rows.label: VERSE

rows.label: BANNING

rows.label: ALPHA

rows.label: REPHRASING

rows.label: EDITION
rows.clue: The form in which a text (especially a printed book) is published

rows.label: LOANWORD

rows.label: DACTYL
rows.clue: A metrical unit with stressed-unstressed-unstressed syllables

rows.label: PLAY READING

rows.label: TIMETABLE

rows.label: ELUCIDATION
rows.clue: An act of explaining that serves to clear up and cast light on

rows.label: DISCO

rows.label: SMALL TALK
rows.clue: Light informal conversation for social occasions

rows.label: ETHNIC JOKE

rows.label: PRINT MEDIA

rows.label: RHETORIC
rows.clue: Using language effectively to please or persuade

rows.label: PROSE POEM
rows.clue: Prose that resembles poetry

rows.label: SYNCOPATION
rows.clue: (phonology) the loss of sounds from within a word (as in `fo'c'sle' for `forecastle')

rows.label: SUPPLEMENT
rows.clue: Textual matter that is added onto a publication

rows.label: QUOTE
rows.clue: A punctuation mark used to attribute the enclosed text to someone else

rows.label: DIATRIBE
rows.clue: Thunderous verbal attack

rows.label: GUMMED LABEL
rows.clue: An adhesive label

rows.label: BREVITY
rows.clue: The use of brief expressions

rows.label: INSERTION
rows.clue: A message (spoken or written) that is introduced or inserted

rows.label: OBLIQUE
rows.clue: Any grammatical case other than the nominative

rows.label: CARDIOGRAM
rows.clue: A graphical recording of the cardiac cycle produced by an electrocardiograph

rows.label: GROUND RULE
rows.clue: (baseball) a special rule (as in baseball) dealing with situations that arise due to the nature of the playing grounds

rows.label: EXHORTATION
rows.clue: A communication intended to urge or persuade the recipients to take some action

rows.label: BULLETIN
rows.clue: A brief report (especially an official statement issued for immediate publication or broadcast)

rows.label: SCHOOL PAPER
rows.clue: A newspaper written and published by students in a school

rows.label: SPLURGE
rows.clue: An ostentatious display (of effort or extravagance etc.)

rows.label: GROCERY LIST
rows.clue: A list of heterogenous items that someone wants

rows.label: OVERVIEW
rows.clue: A general summary of a subject

rows.label: STATUTE BOOK
rows.clue: A record of the whole body of legislation in a given jurisdiction

rows.label: PUZZLE
rows.clue: A particularly baffling problem that is said to have a correct solution

rows.label: PROMISE
rows.clue: A verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future

rows.label: TICKET

rows.label: GRAND OPERA

rows.label: QUARTER REST

rows.label: ROCK CONCERT

rows.label: DESCRIPTION

rows.label: SECRET
rows.clue: Something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)

rows.label: TABLE TALK

rows.label: SYSTEM ERROR

rows.label: FAIRY TALE

rows.label: CONFESSION

rows.label: TOME
